issues.issue: The exception is attached to the entire sign statement, which reads as saying the sign does not apply to the excluded vehicles, rather than merely identifying the category named in the Italian. The Italian makes no exclusion claim. The phrase “excluding motorcycle-class vehicles, including motor tricycles and motor quadricycles” is awkward and potentially suggests all motor quadricycles are excluded; Article 53 makes classification dependent on statutory limits.
